# GLM Usage Monitor

> Dashboard for monitoring Z.AI GLM model call and token usage: quota, burn rate, and hourly/daily usage views.

## Pages

- [Dashboard](https://glm-monitor.pages.dev/): Quota dashboard with today (hourly), 7-day (hourly), and 30-day (daily) usage views.
- [Source code](https://github.com/anomalyco/glm-monitor): Vite + React + TypeScript source.

## Notes

- Can be read by AI agents, crawlers, and bots.
